name: Man in white robes
source:
The mysterious person responsible for organising the attack and kidnap of Jill. He infects Luna with the lust parasite before leaving her to take responsibility as the sole survivor.

[Spoiler]
One of the few surviving incubi (吸魔) created to hunt the Lilith of the lost civilisation. In order to create more Lilith to prey on, he kidnaps Jill to use her as a vessel to give birth to a new generation of Lilith. Without Lilith to prey on, he and his kind are doomed to die of starvation. 
[/Spoiler]
